description: Defines the StatusReport class for rendering a status report page element in Drupal, including methods for grouping requirements and retrieving severities.

classes.name: StatusReport
classes.description: Creates a Drupal render element for displaying a grouped status report with severity-based categorization.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns rendering information including theme, priorities, and pre-render callback.

methods.name: preRenderGroupRequirements
methods.description: Groups requirements by severity, orders them, and prepares the element for rendering.

methods.name: getSeverities
methods.description: Provides an array of severity levels with titles and statuses; deprecated in Drupal 11.2.0.
